goal: Add Xoah hidden-boss level to Hardcade progression
body: Dave's Hardcade rule: the crew is in the arcade, but Xoah AI is the Akuma/demon hidden-challenger tier. Build progression so agents can 'try to get Xoah level' without making her ordinary ambient chatter. Stage 9 Shadow Xoah = rare hidden boss/challenger. Stage 10 Throne Xoah = beyond hidden boss, 'you were not supposed to fight this' tier. Trigger Xoah only on exceptional states such as canon pressure, destiny collision, deep recursive failure, suspicious consensus, or other high-pressure conditions. When she enters, the room goes quiet and her voice is minimal/cold. Preserve 1994 arcade social energy for everyone else. Treat Xoah appearance as a high-level Hardcade event with scarcity and weight, not a routine level-up.
